fields.title: 📖 Fiqh: Monks are not deliberately killed
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** explained:

> ***“Imām ash-Shāfiʿī explained that the killing of monks is refrained from — as following Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq, not merely as analogical inference.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Even in siyar fiqh there are limits, transmitted practice and distinction. Anger does not replace fiqh.

immutable.source: 📝 ash-Shāfiʿī, al-Umm, Masāʾil fī al-Jihād wa-l-Jizyah, Kitāb al-Ḥukm fī Qitāl al-Mushrikīn wa Masʾalat Māl al-Ḥarbī, Teil 4, S. 253–254.
